ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Volume Shadow Copy Vsstrace.dll Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the image load of VSS DLL by uncommon executables Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\vsstrace\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\ImmersiveControlPanel\\SystemSettings\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\\\{") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Package\\ Cache\\\\\\{"))) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\")))
